Application Data.NAME: Sunnyvale Educational Supply Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunnyvale Educational Supply Co. specializes in providing a wide range of educational materials and school supplies, including textbooks, art supplies, electronic learning aids, and seasonal educational kits. We focus on serving local schools, educators, and parents by offering quality products that support learning and development. Our inventory includes both traditional academic supplies and innovative educational tools to enhance classroom experiences. We prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to maintain a secure supply chain, while being aware of potential risks related to inventory management and product authenticity.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, we experienced a theft incident at our retail location, resulting in the loss of premium art supplies valued at $7,000. The authorities were notified, and the case is currently under investigation. Additionally, on August 10, 2023, we discovered spoilage of unsold seasonal educational kits worth $3,000 due to improper storage conditions. This loss has been documented, and we will adjust our inventory management practices accordingly to prevent future occurrences.

Key Risk Considerations
Underwriters should carefully evaluate the following risks commonly
associated with educational and school supply stores:
• Theft or Spoilage of Inventory: High-value or seasonal inventory (e.g., electronic learning
aids, art supplies) is vulnerable to theft, damage, or spoilage. For example, unsold seasonal
stock such as holiday-themed educational kits may lose value if not sold timely.
